statement: An asymptotic formula for the number of totients. Gives an asymptotic equivalent for the number $`V(x)`$ of distinct totient values up to x, with a positive bounded phase-dependent factor determined by convergent arithmetic approximations. In particular, $`V(cx)/V(x)\to c`$ for every fixed c > 0, answering Erdős and Hall’s scaling question.
